sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# probe: move RIGHT 5, check valid_actions + player pos each step
import copy
def player_pos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
print("start player:",player_pos(current_frame),"valid:",valid_actions)
for i in range(5):
    r=action(['RIGHT'])
    print(f"after RIGHT {i+1}: player={player_pos(current_frame)} valid={valid_actions} changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
